description: Create the API key that unlocks the full tool set in this session and keeps access afterwards (the user saves it as TRONRENTAL_API_KEY). Needs the sign-in token. Issued only once the account's top-ups reach the bar (100 TRX on tronrental.com); below it the call reports how much more to top up. The key is shown only once — tell the user to save it.
name: create_api_key
